notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
Tropical Liquor has now been updated to version 1.0.2.

Changelog:

[*]Fixed an issue where save data partially or completely does not get saved.
[*]When data is saved, a backup file will be created (game.backup.sav)
[*]It's unclear whether the game is updated or not so now the version number will be listed on the menu screen above the Tentacle Games logo.
